blocks.text: For more than two decades, casual moviegoers who only knew Marvel’s merry mutants through the silver screen were fed a rather incomplete story. At the turn of the millennium, the live-action X-Men films painted Scott Summers—better known to longtime comic book readers and collectors as Cyclops—as the rigid, buttoned-up boy scout standing in the way of Logan’s brooding anti-hero cool. He was reduced to the guy who wore the ruby-quartz visor, barked a few stiff orders, and largely took a back seat while Wolverine sliced his way into the spotlight.
